title: Airbnb Paris Stay Search Automation

steps.description: Type 'Paris' into the 'Search destinations' or 'Where' search input field
Click on the time selection or 'Check in' date button
Select 22 July as start date from the calendar
Select 23 July as end date from the calendar
Click on the Search button to execute the search
Verify that search results or stay listings in Paris for July 22-23 are displayed on the page

expectedResult: Airbnb search results in Paris for July 22-23 are displayed.
